title: BReD: Block Replay Dithering for Stable Low-Bit EMA Optimizer States
abstract: arXiv:2611.33951v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-bit storage of optimizer states can substantially reduce the memory footprint of large-scale training. In practice, however, these states are not quantized once: at every training step, they are dequantized, updated, requantized, and written back. This iterative quantization pipeline can destabilize training. We identify a failure mode behind this instability: for states updated via exponential moving averages (EMAs), quantization errors are recursively fed into subsequent updates. As a result, biased errors accumulate over time while high-variance errors are amplified, particularly when the EMA decay factor is close to 1. To address this error accumulation, we propose BReD (Block Replay Dithering), a method that reduces rounding bias and controls rounding variance during quantization. BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither value

translated_title: BReD：用于稳定低比特 EMA 优化器状态的块重放抖动方法
translated_abstract: 优化器状态的低比特存储可以大幅减少大规模训练的内存占用。然而在实践中，这些状态并非只被量化一次：在每个训练步骤中，它们都会被反量化、更新、重新量化并写回。这种迭代式的量化流程可能会破坏训练的稳定性。我们识别出了导致这种不稳定性的一个失效模式：对于通过指数移动平均（EMA）更新的状态，量化误差会被递归地引入后续更新中。因此，有偏误差会随时间不断累积，而高方差误差则会被放大，尤其是当 EMA 衰减因子接近 1 时。为了解决这种误差累积问题，我们提出了 BReD（块重放抖动），一种在量化过程中减少舍入偏差并控制舍入方差的方法。BReD 通过将确定性种子重放与分块共享的抖动值相结合，将经典的减法抖动技术适配到了优化器状态量化中。
tldr: 提出 BReD 方法，通过将确定性种子重放与分块共享抖动值相结合的块重放抖动技术，减少 EMA 优化器状态迭代量化中的舍入偏差并控制舍入方差，从而解决误差累积问题、稳定大规模训练。
en_tdlr: BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither values, reducing rounding bias and controlling rounding variance to prevent error accumulation in low-bit EMA optimizer states and stabilize large-scale training.
